messages:
maria (docs): opening a small PR to modernize streaming + pagination snippets across py/ts/go. goal: show iterator-based streaming, deterministic resume token usage, and a lightweight client-side retry pattern. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999
raj (eng-runtime): 👍 can we make the TS example show AbortController usage for cancellation? people often ask how to cancel inflight streams.
elliot (eng-ml): and show a short note about model-switching risks (quantized vs float). we had a subtle repeat-token issue in a customer integration.
maria (docs): yes to both. plan for three tiny examples:
- py: async for chunk in client.stream(...): with exponential backoff wrapper and explicit resume-token handling
- ts: for-await-of with AbortController + optional resume token param
- go: channel read with context.Context and reattach with resume token sample
tara (eng-platform): FYI snip-harness failed earlier on a go snippet due to missing context timeout; please add a short timeout to keep the CI stable.
snip-ci: snippet-harness: failed job `docs-examples` - file examples/go/stream_resume_example.go line 23 (context deadline exceeded). logs: https://ci.internal/snippets/2345
maria (docs): thanks. i'll add context.WithTimeout in the go sample. also, should we keep the old callback examples? i vote for a small legacy note instead of full examples.
elliot (eng-ml): archive the callbacks under /legacy and add a clear deprecation blurb: "Callback API is deprecated for new integrations; prefer iterator-based streaming for simpler error handling."
raj (eng-runtime): i'll add a short paragraph to the streaming docs about server semantics for resume tokens: what is guaranteed (best-effort, useful for short reconnect windows) and what isn't (not durable across model variant or major checkpoint ).
maria (docs): great. one docs nit: include a brief table mapping resume-token states to recommended client action (e.g., token present -> reattach; token expired -> full restart).
tara (eng-platform): added a CI comment in the PR about snippet filename kebab-case and small linter issues. merge-bot: will block until green.
merge-bot: status: pending checks (snip-lint, snippet-harness).
maria (docs): added tests to exercise resume token path (unit-mock) and fixed the go timeout. pushed.
snip-ci: snippet-harness: all checks passed on branch docs/iterator-snippets.
merge-bot: merging in 2m if no objections. tag on merge: `docs: streaming iterator snippets`
raj (eng-runtime): small request: add a line about token accounting for long-lived connections (we bill tokens consumed even while streaming open). put under "cost considerations".
maria (docs): added. final call: @elliot @tara any blockers?
elliot (eng-ml): lgtm from my side.
tara (eng-platform): lgtm. pulling the merge. thanks all! :rocket:
